description: React component for configuring content filtering rules, including patterns, keywords, and categories, with modal dialogs and file upload validation.

methods.name: handleAddPrebuiltPattern
methods.description: Adds a prebuilt pattern to the list, with validation and state updates.

methods.name: handleAddCustomPattern
methods.description: Adds a custom regex pattern to the list, with validation and state updates.

methods.name: handleAddKeyword
methods.description: Adds a new blocked keyword to the list, with validation and state updates.

methods.name: handleFileUpload
methods.description: Validates and processes uploaded YAML files for blocked words, using an access token.
